summary: The diff implements %TypedArray%.prototype.copyWithin in its own file, step by step, with the spec text kept as comments. I walked every step and found no defects. Argument coercion runs in spec order (target, start, end). The count clamping, the step 8.f recompute, the overlap direction logic and the byte-copy loop all match the spec. Errors from ValidateTypedArray and ToIntegerOrInfinity propagate with `?`. The added RangeError and the two "no buffer" / "not a TypedArray" TypeErrors sit on paths that cannot be reached for a valid TypedArray. There is no test-specific branching and no unrelated file changes. Two things I could not verify from the diff alone: whether ops already provides ToAbsoluteIndex/ToClampedIndex (the helper here is a local re-implementation, which the ticket allows only if the report says so), and whether step 8.c's use of validate_typed_array is observably identical to ValidateTypedArrayBounds (it should be, since RequireInternalSlot has no side effects on a TypedArray).
